sentences.text:
This criminal miscellaneous case is filed with following prayers:
(i) To quash entire proceedings against the petitioner in Crime No. 800/2009 on the file of Hosdurg Police Station and which is now pending as CC. No. 3255/2014 on the file of JFCM Court, Hosdurg (ii) Issue any other relief that this Hon'ble High Court may deem fit to grant in the facts and circumstances of the case.
When this matter came up for consideration, this Court directed the Registry to get a report from the trial court and find out whether the case is still pending against the petitioner.
The learned Magistrate submitted a report stating that the case is now pending as LPC 37/2018, which stands posted to 18.10.2024 and a warrant is also pending against the accused.
The above case is charge sheeted alleging offences punishable under Sections 323 and 498A read with Section 34 IPC.
When this matter came up today, it is submitted that the matter is settled.
The Public Prosecutor also submitted that the matter is settled.
Since it is a matrimonial offence, I am of the considered opinion that the continuation prosecution against the petitioner is not necessary.
Therefore, this criminal miscellaneous case is allowed.

All further proceedings against the petitioner in LPC No.37/2018 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Hosdurg, arising from Crime No.800/2009 of Hosdurg Police Station, are quashed.
